column1: # Entries build/lib/mkvendor.py adds to (or removes from) the stock vendor tree.
# Stock entries keep their stock owner, mode and capabilities; their SELinux
# label comes from the stock file_contexts, as on a real /vendor partition.
#          comp:PATH       file in the release components directory
#          stock:LIST      every vendor path listed in LIST, copied from stock system_a
#          remove          delete this stock path and everything below it
